question: The Twitter account @rgowans, known as ‘Migrant Rescue Watch’, has caused serious concern over its activities in recent months, including publishing Libyan militias’ commemorative material and disclosing Italian and European armed forces’ top-secret documents.

It has also published posts publicly intimidating Father Mattia Ferrari, chaplain on board the Mar Ionio, and journalist Nello Scavo, who has identified @rgowans as the ‘spokesperson of the Libyan mafia’ and as being linked to the intelligence services of a number of countries.

In the legal action for libel and threats brought by Father Ferrari, the judge responsible for preliminary investigations rejected the request for dismissal made by the Public Prosecutor’s Office and ordered further investigations to identify the account’s authors and managers.

A journalistic investigation revealed the name of the owner of the account in question, which, it turns out, is the same as that of the director of the Asseco data centre1. Asseco is a company that provides the software platform used by Frontex, which has collected data from more than 500 people in two years. In the light of the above: 1.
Is the Commission aware of this situation?
Has it ascertained from Frontex and Asseco whether it is a coincidence that the names are the same?
If not, what steps has it taken or does it intend to take to protect the institution itself?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (13.5.2024) The Commission became aware of the existence of this account in July 2023 in particular through a letter to the President of the Commission from 16 Members of the European Parliament1.

The Commission contacted the European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex) to establish whether there had been any association between the person alleged to be behind the account and Frontex. Following an internal investigation, the Agency confirmed that it had never had contact with the Twitter account in question and that the person who appears to be behind the account has never been employed by Frontex.
